parsed.rationale: The second participating record lives at `Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift` and carries `is_sample_app: true`, placing it squarely in a sample/example app target. The near-identical `DebugMetricsProvider` in `Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift` is the canonical implementation; the sample-app copy is a self-contained convenience duplicate that avoids a hard dependency from the example app on the `DebugPanel` package. The only structural difference — `metalDevice:MTLDevice?` vs `metalDevice:(any MTLDevice)?` — is a minor existential-syntax variant consistent with the sample app being compiled under different Swift language settings, not a meaningful semantic divergence. Extracting or unifying these would couple the sample app to `DebugPanel`, which is the dependency direction the sample-app pattern is specifically designed to avoid.
